considerations: Review November 16, 2026 UTC first and verify the user had a page or project in scope at that time. Some infrastructure is reused, so outside-window matches can be unrelated.
Compare endpoint browsing, CSP reports and application access logs. Distinguish blocked attempts, successful browser access, and any validated exposure using proxy action and corroborating records.
A connection to the reported collection endpoint is a higher-priority lead. Destination contact alone does not establish which site initiated it or whether information was transmitted.
description: Match proxy or firewall destinations against the exact domains confirmed in Optimizely's incident report and identify the reported role of each destination.

evidence.claim: Optimizely reports edits to customer Project JavaScript following exploitation of a signup flaw. Its forensic investigation identified separate skimmer hosting and collection domains.
evidence.location: How the attack worked and section 10, Indicators of compromise

expected_output: One row per matching proxied or logged connection, with the exact domain, campaign role, client, and connector action.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Contact with Optimizely's confirmed skimmer infrastructure around November 16 is a lead for downstream browser exposure associated with CVE-2026-132224.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Optimizely Web Experimentation Skimmer Connections

1.json:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| extend RequestHost = tolower(trim_end(@"[.]+", coalesce(tostring(parse_url(RequestURL).Host), RequestURL)))
| extend ConnectionHost = tolower(trim_end(@"[.]+", coalesce(tostring(parse_url(DestinationHostName).Host), DestinationHostName)))
| extend MatchedDomain = case(RequestHost in ("pay-cloud.online", "pay.pay-cloud.online", "pay-relay.wordpressadmin001.workers.dev"), RequestHost, ConnectionHost in ("pay-cloud.online", "pay.pay-cloud.online", "pay-relay.wordpressadmin001.workers.dev"), ConnectionHost, "")
| where isnotempty(MatchedDomain)
| extend IndicatorRole = iff(MatchedDomain == "pay-relay.wordpressadmin001.workers.dev", "Reported collection endpoint", "Reported skimmer infrastructure")
| project TimeGenerated, MatchedDomain, IndicatorRole, SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceAction, DeviceProduct, RequestURL
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
